name: Philips Avent Bottle Nipple Natural 3 Month Plus 2pcs
description:
rand: Philips Avent
Product Type: Baby Bottle Nipple / Teat
Quantity: 2 pcs
Age Group: 3 months+
Origin: Made in Indonesia
Material: BPA-free silicone

Features & Benefits

Natural Breast-Like Design: Wide, breast-shaped nipple mimics the feel of the breast for an easy transition between breast and bottle feeding.

Ultra-Soft & Flexible: Comfort petals and spiral design make the nipple soft, flexible, and comfortable for baby.

Advanced Anti-Colic System: Twin valve ensures air flows into the bottle, not the baby’s tummy, reducing gas and fussiness.

Controlled Milk Flow: Smaller hole size provides slower, more controlled milk flow for a contented feeding experience.

Easy to Clean: Dishwasher safe or can be hand-washed in warm soapy water.

Compatible: Designed for use with Philips Avent Natural feeding bottles.
